Generated by tools/figures/pages3d_readme.py from the pages in docs/3d and the checks that open them. The pages show concept geometry and synthetic results: design aids with no evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: 3D = three-dimensional · CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · EC-nnn =

edge case found by a failure search · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · HTML = HyperText Markup Language (web page) · KB = kilobyte, a file size of
1,024 bytes · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · S3-nnn = 3D hazard scene (sim/scenes3d) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SITL =
software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
